channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Raymond Felton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Raymond Felton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Raymond Felton
item.description:
Fred Katz:Doc Rivers on Ray Felton:

“He’s one of my favorites. He goes on my list. When you have 18 years, you have a long list, but he’s really high on it. I just love him.”

Doc Rivers on Raymond Felton, Nov 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Raymond Felton, Austin Rivers
item.description:
Clippers coach Doc Rivers said.

“The guy that played the minutes before was Austin, he played those (40-minute games). We don’t want to do that. That’s probably why we didn’t play as hard, because guys were playing too many minutes. I think J.J.’s minutes have to go up a little bit, Jamal’s minutes will have to go up because we don’t want to tax Raymond and Austin to the point that they’re not doing what they do well. Raymond’s a great ball pressure guy. If you start playing him 38 minutes, his ball pressure goes down.”

Doc Rivers on Raymond Felton, Austin Rivers, Jan 18, 2017. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Zaza Pachulia
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on the decision to replace Zaza Pachulia with Raymond Felton in the starting five:

“We changed the lineup just because we needed a shakeup. Everything is on the table game to game.”

Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Zaza Pachulia, Mar 14, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Wesley Matthews
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on opting to play Raymond Felton ($3.95 million salary) over Wesley Matthews ($16.4 million salary) in crunch time:

“I don't look at money. We're trying to win basketball games. You've got to look at the guys available and what their value is in that particular situation. It's simply a coach's decision.”

Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Wesley Matthews, Mar 10, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton
item.description:
#Mavs coachRick Carlisle on Felton:

“He’s a damn good player, that’s what he is. I’m happy for him that he’s having a really good year.”

Rick Carlisle on Raymond Felton, Feb 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle:

“We’re going 2 keep all our point guards. All those guys, Williams, Barea, Harris, Felton, those guys are going 2 be on the team.”

Rick Carlisle on Devin Harris, Raymond Felton, Deron Williams, JJ Barea, Oct 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: George Karl on Raymond Felton
item.description:
Karl gushed about Felton who is back in his second tour with the Knicks who thumped the Nuggets, 112-106, last night at the Garden.

“I wish I had known how to handle the Ty-Raymond [situation] because there’s a part of me that thought that was a great way to go.“But Raymond, when we gave Ty the starting job, it was pretty clear Raymond wanted to be a starter somewhere in the league and he’s good enough to be,”

George Karl on Raymond Felton, Dec 10, 2012. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Raymond Felton
item.description:
Earlier this month, New York had already signed Kidd; now, Lin saw the writing on the wall, along with everybody else.

“Felton's signing was the first time when I thought, 'Oh, wow, I might not be a Knick,'”

Jeremy Lin on Raymond Felton, Jul 18, 2012. Source: SI.com.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Raymond Felton
item.description:
Blazers coachNate McMillan on benching of Raymond Felton:

“I believe in Raymond. Raymond is going to be fine. He will still be in the rotation and we're going to need him to play well... I made the decision after last night's game, looking at our rhythm and our start that I was going to change the rotation... This is a decision made for tonight.”

Nate McMillan on Raymond Felton, Feb 22, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: George Karl on Raymond Felton
item.description:
“My hope is Raymond and (Ty) could stay together and kind of work the point guard position into a two-guard position,”

George Karl on Raymond Felton, May 1, 2011. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Tony Dutt on Raymond Felton
item.description:
The agent for Raymond Felton will meet tonight with Denver Nuggets general manager Masai Ujiri to discuss his client's present and future role with the club.

“I really want to clarify with him that Raymond is not going to be a backup,”

Tony Dutt on Raymond Felton, Feb 23, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Larry Brown on Raymond Felton
item.description:
Steve Adamek:Larry Brown on his former PG Raymond Felton:

“He's died and gone to heaven going from me to Mike [D'antoni].”

Larry Brown on Raymond Felton, Nov 24, 2010. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Raymond Felton
item.description:
“He works extremely hard at his craft. Raymond's special in his own different way. We're looking for him to reach his full potential.”

Amare Stoudemire on Raymond Felton, Oct 11, 2010. Source: New York Post.
